# DevPul

> Open source debug bridge between a running Dart or Flutter app and a browser UI. The app posts HTTP calls, errors, logs, session info, route changes and custom events with `dart:developer` `postEvent`; the browser reads them live from the Dart Development Service (DDS) websocket on 127.0.0.1. Runs only in the browser: no proxy, no certificates, no server, nothing sent anywhere. Debug builds only. MIT licensed.

The hosted UI is at %SITE_URL%. It also runs locally with `npx devpul` or as a downloaded single HTML file.

## Docs

- [Getting started](%SITE_URL%docs/): packages, setup, first connection.
- [Connecting](%SITE_URL%docs/connecting/): pasted URLs, `#connect=` links, fixed port, IDEs, `flutter attach`, Flutter web.
- [Using the UI](%SITE_URL%docs/ui/): filter syntax (`status:4xx ms:>500 host: tag:`), sorting, shortcuts, HAR and session export, actions.
- [Core API](%SITE_URL%docs/api/): `Devpul.session`, `tags`, `emit`, `log`, `error`, `action`, `DevpulConfig`, redaction.
- [Dio](%SITE_URL%docs/dio/), [package:http](%SITE_URL%docs/http/), [Flutter](%SITE_URL%docs/flutter/): adapters and hooks.
- [Extending DevPul](%SITE_URL%docs/extend/): send any data with `Devpul.emit`, Riverpod `ProviderObserver` and Bloc `BlocObserver` examples, a State plugin, actions.
- [Plugins](%SITE_URL%docs/plugins/): ES module tabs for custom event kinds, with a render context that can call the app.
- [Writing an HTTP adapter](%SITE_URL%docs/adapters/) and [Event contract](%SITE_URL%docs/events/): `DevpulHttp` and the `devpul.*` event schema.
- [Help and FAQ](%SITE_URL%help/): troubleshooting and privacy.

## Packages

- [devpul](%REPO_URL%/tree/main/packages/devpul): pure Dart core, web compatible.
- [devpul_dio](%REPO_URL%/tree/main/packages/devpul_dio): `DevpulDioInterceptor` for Dio.
- [devpul_http](%REPO_URL%/tree/main/packages/devpul_http): `DevpulClient` for package:http.
- [devpul_flutter](%REPO_URL%/tree/main/packages/devpul_flutter): Flutter errors with diagnostics, `debugPrint` capture, `DevpulNavigatorObserver`.
- [launcher](%REPO_URL%/tree/main/launcher): `npx devpul [vm-service-url]` serves the UI on 127.0.0.1.
